clue.text: How dishonestly a bishop proceeds?

definitions.meaning: old slang for crooked dealing, the opposite of being on the square, honest
a chess bishop travels only diagonally, crosswise over the board

explanation.surface: A question about how a churchman goes about his business crookedly.
explanation.walkthrough: The bishop is the chess piece, not a cleric: it moves diagonally, in a cross shape. The same phrase is slang for acting dishonestly.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is slang for crooked behaviour and also describes the diagonal path of a chess piece.

clue.text: Religious representative caught, in union agitation

indicators.note: in places the caught letter inside the stirred-up union letters
agitation stirs up the letters of the word union into a new order

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A trade union meeting erupts and someone is caught up in the commotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'agitation' rearranges UNION to NUNIO, and 'in' puts C (caught) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A papal envoy, the Pope's ambassador to a foreign government, is a church diplomat.

clue.text: Mooring rope for commander with fleet

parts.note: a head is a leader or chief in command
fleet as an adjective means swift or quick

explanation.surface: A naval commander in charge of a fleet of ships, with a rope for tying up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fleet' reads as a group of ships but is the adjective meaning quick.
explanation.definitionFit: A line from a vessel's bow tying it to a quay is a mooring line of this name.

clue.text: Top race in China

parts.note: the crown is the top of the head or of a hat
the Derby is a famous English horse race run at Epsom

explanation.surface: The leading horse race held in China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' is not the country but porcelain: this is a fine English porcelain made in Derby. The DERBY is England's best-known flat horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a famous brand of English porcelain tableware, the fine ceramic called china.

clue.text: Keep watch, say

definitions.meaning: to look on attentively and monitor

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to watch attentively and to remark on something in speech.

clue.text: Expression of despair, in a sense, cut short

indicators.note: cut short tells us to remove the final letter of the sense word

parts.note: sight is one of the five senses

explanation.surface: A despairing look, cut off before it can be fully expressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' drops the last letter T from SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhaling audibly is a way of showing weariness or hopelessness.

clue.text: Saint makes proclamation under peak

indicators.note: in a down clue, under places the proclamation word beneath the peak word

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain peak, as in Ben Nevis
an edict is an official decree or proclamation

explanation.surface: A holy man delivers a pronouncement from below a mountain top.
explanation.walkthrough: BEN is Scottish for a mountain (Ben Nevis is Britain's highest peak).
explanation.definitionFit: The founder of Western monasticism is the sixth-century St Benedict of Nursia.

clue.text: Discourage — almost reject — the article as discourteous

parts.note: to unman is to deprive of courage or nerve

indicators.note: reject tells us to throw the article out of the word for almost

parts.note: nearly means almost
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Putting someone off, nearly turning them down, is rude.
explanation.walkthrough: The dashes make 'almost reject' look like one phrase; in fact 'almost' is NEARLY and 'reject the article' removes A, giving NERLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking good manners or politeness means being rude.

clue.text: Home-bird employed in US hospital

parts.note: in means at home
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A stay-at-home type who works in an American hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Home-bird' looks like one word for a stay-at-home person, but it splits in two. The definition uses the American sense of a hospital trainee doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage this is a junior doctor working and training in a hospital.

clue.text: Disgraceful batting noted

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is said to be in
noted means well known

explanation.surface: A shameful batting performance that became well known.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the team batting is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a bad reputation, being notorious, is shameful.

clue.text: It's quickly over edge, in record time

indicators.note: in tells us the edge word goes inside the record and time words

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an era is a period of time
a hem is the edge of a cloth

explanation.surface: Something passes swiftly over the edge, setting a record time.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: something that is quickly over is short-lived.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that last only a short time are transient and fleeting.

clue.text: Strong man discards odd pieces in clothing

indicators.note: dropping the odd-numbered letters leaves the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of the phrase

explanation.surface: A muscleman throwing off odd bits of his outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discards odd pieces' keeps the even letters of STRONG MAN: T, O, G, A.
explanation.definitionFit: A Roman citizen's loose outer robe is a garment.

clue.text: Opportunist in paper, always about right

parts.note: The Times is a newspaper

indicators.note: about puts the always word around the letter for right

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: An opportunist who writes in the newspaper, always about the right wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the word for always round R; the hyphenated answer is one who serves the times.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who adapts their views to suit those in power is a self-serving opportunist.

clue.text: Transfer of power left you reportedly dividing loyalty

indicators.note: dividing says the left and you letters split the loyalty word in two

parts.note: devotion is loyalty

indicators.note: reportedly means the word you is taken by its spoken sound, a single letter

parts.note: you is pronounced like the letter U

explanation.surface: Power handed over because loyalty has been split.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' turns 'you' into the letter U by sound; 'dividing' puts L and U into DEVOTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Delegation of authority from central government to regions is the political sense.

clue.text: Celebrities divide up the main part

parts.note: lions are celebrities, as in literary lions
to share is to divide up

explanation.surface: Famous people carve up the bulk of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lions' in the sense of celebrities is a dated but standard usage.
explanation.definitionFit: The biggest portion, from the fable in which the lion takes most of the kill.

clue.text: Plant collected, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the collected word is taken by its sound

parts.note: mustered means gathered together, collected

explanation.surface: Someone gathered a crop and we have heard about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a verb but is a noun: the yellow-flowered crop.
explanation.definitionFit: The condiment comes from the seeds of a yellow-flowered brassica crop.

clue.text: Braces for boyfriends

definitions.meaning: as a verb, supports or holds firm
regular sweethearts, as in going steady

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means steadying or supporting; the noun means regular partners in a romance.

clue.text: Carrier or merchant vessel

definitions.meaning: a small tray or stand that carries a bottle or glass
a trading ship that sails along the coast

explanation.definitionFit: It names both a drinks mat or tray and a ship trading between coastal ports.

clue.text: Bridge player with hand making unorthodox lead

parts.note: in bridge the four players are named North, South, East and West
a paw is a hand, informally

explanation.surface: A card player, with a hand dealt, makes an unusual opening lead.
explanation.walkthrough: The lead is a boxer's, not a card lead: a left-handed boxer leads with the right, the unorthodox stance.
explanation.definitionFit: A left-handed boxer or pitcher, who leads with the right instead of the usual left.

clue.text: Sounds like this country's top scorer

indicators.note: sounds like means the word for this country is taken by how it is said

parts.note: this country, for a British newspaper, is Britain

explanation.surface: A leading striker named after the nation he plays for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scorer' is not a goalscorer but a composer who writes scores: Benjamin Britten, a leading English composer.
explanation.definitionFit: A major English composer, writer of musical scores such as Peter Grimes.

clue.text: Skates round enclosed place and balances

indicators.note: round puts the skates word around the enclosed place

parts.note: steels as a loose term for skates, whose blades are steel
a yard is an enclosed area

explanation.surface: Skaters circle a fenced-off rink and keep their balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'balances' is a noun: weighing devices, not the act of keeping upright.
explanation.definitionFit: A steelyard is a weighing scale with a sliding weight on a lever arm.

clue.text: Threatening is not fair

definitions.meaning: menacing, as an ... mood or situation

explanation.definitionFit: It means both menacing and unattractive.

clue.text: Deal too persistently with workers

definitions.meaning: to dwell on something too long, as in harping on a point

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means overstressing a point; as a noun it means the body of workers.

clue.text: Warning to port at night

parts.note: a ship shows a coloured navigation lamp on its port side after dark, and the same signal colour means stop in traffic

explanation.definitionFit: A stop signal in traffic, and the colour of the lamp a vessel shows on its left side.

clue.text: Colour on target, or on shield

definitions.meaning: the bullseye of an archery target is this colour
or is the heraldic word for this tincture on a coat of arms

explanation.definitionFit: The yellow centre of an archery target, and the heraldic tincture called or.

clue.text: It comes in useful for a pot one's brewing

indicators.note: brewing stirs the letters of a pot one's into a new order

parts.note: the apostrophe drops and the letters are used as written

explanation.surface: A handy implement when making a pot of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brewing' rearranges A POT ONES into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small spoon used for stirring and measuring is a handy implement at tea time.

clue.text: Beautiful woman's comprehensive view

explanation.definitionFit: Informally a striking beauty, and also a good long look at something.

clue.text: Drudgery for fellow with vital job

parts.note: a don is a college fellow
key means essential
work is a job

explanation.surface: A college fellow does tedious work that is essential.
explanation.walkthrough: A DON is a university teacher, especially a fellow of an Oxford or Cambridge college.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard, tedious labour is grinding toil.
